title: MSI-Bench: Evaluating Multi-Speaker Voice Interaction for Collaborative AI Agents
claim: 1,152 multi-party audio scenes with expected tool calls; best system passes 66.8% EN / 54.5% ZH; open-weight models bottlenecked by multi-speaker audio front-end.
not_covered: Multi-speaker perception; no spoken-entity ledger, no pipeline or acoustic factorial, no confirmation lever.

title: MTVA-Bench: Evaluating the Language Model Inside Cascaded Voice Agents
claim: Evaluates the text LLM under cascade conditions with an LLM caller and a mock backend answering the arguments actually sent; argument values are a main driver of a 24.4-pt score spread.
not_covered: Simulated transcript artefacts, no real ASR or audio-native arm, no acoustic conditions, no entity-type silent-wrong cell, no lever comparison.

title: From Intent to Action: Benchmarking LLM Safety in Vehicle Voice Command Authorization
claim: 202-scenario benchmark of the pre-action decision (execute/refuse/clarify/confirm/defer) for vehicle voice commands; alignment 40.1-89.1%, persistent confirmation errors.
not_covered: Text scenarios about authorization, not mis-heard entities; no audio, no pipelines.

title: The Hidden Cost of Digits: Number Normalization and WER in ASR Systems
claim: Lack of number normalization shifts ASR WER by >2 pts, often larger than between-system differences.
not_covered: Metric hygiene only; no agent, no tool calls, no recovery.

title: A frontend-backend architecture for tool calls in full-duplex speech models
claim: Duplex speech-to-text frontend emits a delegation token to a text backend LLM for tool calls; 92-97% tool-call recall.
not_covered: Architecture paper; no wrong-argument ledger, no acoustic factorial, no confirmation lever.

title: Fabrication After Tool Failure: Tool-Augmented Agents Assert Values Their Tools Did Not Return
claim: Tool-augmented agents assert unsupported values 0.0% when a tool returns status:error but 45.3% when it returns status:ok with corrupted content.
not_covered: Text-only, tool-output side; the input-side silent-wrong cell from mis-heard speech is untouched.

title: tau-Elicitation: Benchmarking multi-turn entity extraction in voice agents
claim: 200-task voice benchmark over 10 entity types with 5 caller voices and 3 environments; audio-native agents reach robust exact success 0.14-0.41; only 24-37% of verified errors repaired; a spell/read-back/confirm scaffold adds 14-31 Pass^3 points at 21-28 s per call.
not_covered: Audio-native realtime models only (caller-side ASR deliberately omitted): no Whisper cascade, no audio-LLM transcriber arm, no ASR-confidence/n-best gating lever, no WER covariate, no telephone band or speaking rate, no voices-per-accent design, no formal silent-wrong rate per entity type x condition, no false-positive cost of confirmation.

title: MP-Bench: Evaluating Voice Agents as a Multiparty Conversation Participant
claim: First benchmark of voice agents as active multi-party participants (turn-taking awareness, response appropriateness).
not_covered: Different question; no entity or tool-argument measurement.

title: VoiceCodeBench: Evaluating Exact Structured-Token Recovery in Automatic Speech Recognition
claim: 1,482 audited entities across 26 types (phone, currency, date, time, account number, spelled sequences) on 19 ASR systems; WER nearly uncorrelated with entity recovery (rho -0.28) or task success; best TSR 68.7%.
not_covered: ASR transcripts only: no LLM, no tool call, no execution, no audio-LLM transcriber, clean audio only, no noise/telephone, no recovery lever.

title: SpeechGym: An Audio-Native Gym for Training Voice Agents via Reinforcement Learning
claim: Audio-native tau2-bench self-play with Qwen3-Omni; mis-heard slot values in 32% of speech rollouts vs 2% in text; failures are perceptual (right tool, right slot, wrong value); per-turn process reward fixes GRPO sparsity.
not_covered: RL training paper with one open model and clean self-play audio; no cascade comparison, no acoustic factorial, no measured confirmation or gating lever, no silent-vs-asked ledger.

title: Benchmarking LLM Judges for Voice-Agent Evaluation: Reliability, Calibration, and Human Oversight
claim: Human vs GPT-4.1/GPT-5 judges on telecom/retail voice-agent calls; judge reliability is metric- and configuration-dependent.
not_covered: Judge reliability; no entity-error measurement.

title: Outcome Monitors: Recovery Affordances for Silent Tool Failures
claim: Outcome-contract monitors detect silent tool failures that arrive in the expected format; ToolMaze completion 10.9%->28.1%.
not_covered: Text agents, tool-output side; nothing about mis-heard inputs or voice.

title: FormBharo: Designing and Evaluating a Voice Agent for Conversational Form Filling in Rural India
claim: Hindi phone voice agent for form filling with deterministic validation; FormVoiceAgentBench with 3,760 tests over 960 simulated calls scoring transcription, extraction and completion.
not_covered: Single deployment and language; no pipeline comparison, no entity-type silent-wrong ledger, no lever comparison with cost.

title: Spoken Function Calling: A New Perspective on Spoken Language Understanding for Large Audio Language Models
claim: Reframes SLU as spoken function calling; SFC-Bench synthesized from SLU datasets; evaluates LLMs/LALMs and post-trains LALMs.
not_covered: Semantic-extraction accuracy only; no silent-wrong cell, no acoustic factorial, no cascade-vs-native under telephone band, no confirmation lever.

title: VAmoS Bench: Voice Agent Simulation Bench
claim: End-to-end phone simulation with a seeded SQL backend and five real tools; grader checks arguments and rows and catches agents that claim changes without making them.
not_covered: 100 single-domain scenarios; containment scoring, no entity-type or acoustic factorial, no lever comparison.

title: CORTIS: Text-Only Adaptation of Spoken Language Models for Task-Oriented Voice Agents
claim: Text-only adaptation of Qwen2.5-Omni for speech-to-structured outputs vs matched ASR-LLM cascades; advantages under acoustic degradation.
not_covered: Training method; no error-type ledger, no confirmation or gating lever, no telephone/accent factorial.

title: IHBench: Evaluating Post-Interruption Recovery in Voice Agents with Structured Workflows
claim: Six interruption types injected into state-machine workflows across 10 domains; 27 audio-LM configurations scored on recovery quality.
not_covered: Interruption recovery, not entity mis-hearing.

title: Uncertainty-Aware Clarification in LLM Agents with Information Gain
claim: Information-gain reward trains a clarifier in a clarification-enhanced tau-Bench; +3.7% success at +0.3 steps.
not_covered: Text-only intent ambiguity; no speech, no mis-heard entities, no read-back comparison.

title: Towards Human-Like Interactive Speech Recognition With Agentic Correction and Semantic Evaluation
claim: Interactive ASR as multi-turn refinement with semantic correction and a sentence-level semantic error rate; large semantic gains on entity-intensive and code-switching sets.
not_covered: Stops at the transcript: no tool calls, no pipelines, no acoustic factorial, no lever cost accounting.

title: Proactive for Uncertainty: Cause-Aware Error Diagnosis and Interactive Clarification for Spoken Dialogue Systems
claim: ASR confidence filtering fails on deletions and cannot separate acoustic from linguistic errors; cause-aware detectors on ASR latents drive targeted clarification, +17% downstream task across accents and distortions.
not_covered: SDS/WER framing, not a tool-call ledger: no schema-valid-wrong cell, no audio-native arm, no read-back-with-oracle baseline, no turn/token cost.

title: Auditing Bias and Safety in Voice AI Customer Care
claim: Validation-gated audit framework for tool-mediated customer-care voice agents separating native S2S, cascaded and hybrid architectures under matched caller-presentation conditions.
not_covered: Fairness/burden audit design; no entity-error or recovery measurement.

title: From Text to Voice: A Reproducible and Verifiable Framework for Evaluating Tool Calling LLM Agents
claim: Converts Confetti and When2Call to audio via TTS, speaker variation and DEMAND noise at 5-20 dB; 7 omni models plus text and ASR-cascade arms; text-to-voice gap 1.8-4.8 pts; argument-value errors are 54-57% of failures.
not_covered: No recovery lever, no telephone band, no speaking rate or voices-per-accent, no silent-vs-asked ledger, no entity-type breakdown, no lever cost.

title: EVA-Bench: A New End-to-end Framework for Evaluating Voice Agents
claim: Bot-to-bot audio simulation with 213 enterprise scenarios, accent/noise perturbation suite, 12 systems across three architectures; accent/noise gaps up to 0.314.
not_covered: Whole-call composite scores; no entity-level silent-wrong cell, no lever comparison.

title: Audio2Tool: Speak, Call, Act - A Dataset for Benchmarking Speech Tool Use
claim: ~30k spoken tool-calling queries with voice-cloned TTS and diverse noise; SpeechLMs and ASR-LLM pipelines degrade under compositional and acoustic challenges.
not_covered: Pass-rate benchmark; no silent-wrong ledger by entity type, no telephone band, no confirmation or gating lever.

title: Full-Duplex-Bench-v3: Benchmarking Tool Use for Full-Duplex Voice Agents Under Real-World Disfluency
claim: Real human disfluent audio with chained API calls; GPT-Realtime, Gemini Live, Grok, Ultravox and a Whisper->GPT-4o cascade compared on accuracy, latency, turn-taking; GPT-Realtime Pass@1 0.600.
not_covered: Pass@1 and latency only; no wrong-argument cell, no acoustic factorial beyond disfluency, no recovery lever.

title: tau-Voice: Benchmarking Full-Duplex Voice Agents on Real-World Domains
claim: tau2-bench extended to full-duplex voice with accents and audio environments; voice agents reach 31-51% clean and 26-38% realistic vs 85% text.
not_covered: Task pass rate; no entity-type ledger, no cascade-vs-native under telephone band, no confirmation or gating lever.

title: Do What I Say: A Spoken Prompt Dataset for Instruction-Following
claim: Human-recorded spoken vs written prompts across 9 tasks and 11 languages; text prompts consistently beat spoken prompts for SLLMs.
not_covered: Instruction-following, not tool arguments or recovery.

title: Aegis: Towards Governance, Integrity, and Security of AI Voice Agents
claim: Red-teaming framework for voice agents (privacy leakage, privilege escalation, resource abuse); behavioural attacks survive access controls.
not_covered: Adversarial misuse; accidental mis-hearing and confirmation recovery not studied.

title: When and What to Ask: AskBench and Rubric-Guided RLVR for LLM Clarification
claim: AskBench converts QA into multi-turn clarification checkpoints; rubric-guided RLVR improves when/what to ask.
not_covered: Text-only; no speech or entity mis-hearing.

title: Lost in Transcription: How Speech-to-Text Errors Derail Code Understanding
claim: Indic spoken code queries through ASR and LLM refinement; identifiers and code-mixing derail downstream code tasks.
not_covered: Code domain; no tool-call ledger, no pipelines factorial, no confirmation lever.
